# Senior AI/ML Engineer — Applied LLM and Voice

**Location:** Noida (hybrid, 3 days in office)
**Experience:** 4–7 years
**Team:** AI Engineering

## About the role

You will own applied machine learning work across client engagements, mostly
LLM-backed products and real-time voice agents. Our clients are in health,
retail and hospitality, and they generally want something in production rather
than a research result.

This is a hands-on role. You will write code most days, and you will be the
person a client's technical lead talks to when they want to know why a model
behaves the way it does.

## What you will do

- Build and ship LLM-backed features: retrieval, tool calling, agent loops
- Build real-time voice agents, and be responsible for how they behave when the
  conversation goes wrong rather than only when it goes right
- Fine-tune open models where a hosted API is the wrong answer, and be able to
  say clearly when it is not the wrong answer
- Quantise and serve models under real memory and latency constraints
- Design evaluation before building, so a claim about accuracy means something
- Instrument what you ship. A model in production that nobody can observe is a
  model nobody can fix
- Work directly with client stakeholders, including delivering findings they
  did not want

## What we need

- 4+ years in machine learning, with at least 2 shipping to production
- Strong Python. PyTorch or an equivalent framework in daily use
- Practical experience with LLMs beyond prompting: fine-tuning, evaluation,
  serving, or all three
- Experience with speech or real-time audio is a strong advantage
- Comfort with the deployment half: containers, cloud, and enough
  infrastructure knowledge to debug your own service
- The ability to design an experiment that could disprove your own hypothesis

## Nice to have

- Voice agent frameworks such as LiveKit, Pipecat or similar
- Quantisation and inference optimisation
- Computer vision, particularly anomaly detection
- Observability tooling for ML systems

## What matters to us

We are a services business, so the work changes shape often and the deadline
rarely moves. The engineers who do well here are the ones who measure before
they tune, who can tell a client that a number is not real, and who know the
difference between a model that works and a demo that worked once.

Honesty about results matters more here than good results. A negative finding
reported clearly is worth more to us than a positive one nobody can reproduce.
